close_reason: Added 3 dispatcher-based tests for onSuccessSetIsDefault; verifies string id applied, skipped on failure, null is no-op; 36 total pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Integration tests using a stateful MockBackend for onSuccessSetIsDefault path. Oracle: contacts-10 §2.3, §4.2.

**Tests (in addressbook.rs test module or tests/addressbook_tests.rs):**
1. set_on_success_set_is_default_bare_id: string id → target in updated with isDefault:true.
2. set_on_success_set_is_default_creation_ref: create + use #c1 → newly-created book appears in created AND updated with isDefault:true.
3. set_on_success_bad_ref_ignored: non-existent id → silently ignored, notUpdated empty.
4. set_on_success_skipped_on_error: failing create → onSuccessSetIsDefault not applied.
5. set_on_success_new_state_reflects_mutation: only onSuccessSetIsDefault changes → newState != oldState.
6. set_on_success_demoted_book_in_updated: old default book also in updated with isDefault:false.

MockBackend extended to: track isDefault per book, implement single-default invariant.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 6 tests pass with stateful backend.
title: Integration tests: AddressBook/set onSuccessSetIsDefault full coverage
